To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the best system for semantic similarity is a linear combination of string matching metrics and a recurrent neural network using tweet-specific distributed representations; (2) the best system in paraphrase identification is a linear combination that includes a recurrent neural network, a logistic regression on the latent semantic features, and a linear combination of all string metrics; and (3) the best system overall is the same linear combination of systems used in the paraphrase identification task.

the combination of multiple systems and features is more effective for the task of semantic similarity than any individual feature, and the combination of multiple features is more effective than any single feature for the task of paraphrase identification.
(i) string matching metrics are useful in the task of paraphrase identification; and (ii) the combination of multiple systems is a key to achieving good results.
